title: cincinalis tenera
intro: Cincinalis tenera, commonly known as Cinchona bark or Red Cinchona, is a plant species native to the Andean region of South America. It is known for its health benefits, which include the treatment of malaria, fever, and other diseases caused by Plasmodium parasites, due to its anti-malarial properties. The therapeutic actions of C. tenera include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic agent, helping to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms associated with malaria. The bioactive constituents of C. tenera include alkaloids such as quinine and quinidine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
